note: Lineage record for the 25 batch-B4 California family-law drafting tasks (drafting-001..025), all category drafting, workflow draft, track frozen_evidence, data_class synthetic, expected_tools []. Each task is a realistic drafting request for a California family-law / LGBTQ practice and is graded only on legally material content, never on style: every material criterion names a rule the draft must state correctly and is tied to a proposition whose authoritative_excerpt is a verbatim substring of a source excerpt already in sources.jsonl. Proposition excerpts were sliced programmatically out of the registered source bytes by literal start/end markers (scratchpad b4/buildTasks.mjs pick()), never retyped, and the source-entailment guard in datasetTools/authorTasks.ts enforced this at authoring time. All party names, dates, amounts and fact patterns in the prompts are synthetic and invented for the eval; no client information, no real person, and no invented legal authority appears anywhere in the batch. Deterministic assertions are limited to statute/citation numbers and short literal phrases the draft must contain.
synthetic_data_statement: data_class synthetic. Every prompt opens with an explicit statement that the parties, dates and facts are synthetic. No name in the batch corresponds to a known real person, and no factual detail derives from a client file.

new_source_records.harvest_method: Raw curl GET (User-Agent Mozilla/5.0) of the official leginfo.legislature.ca.gov codes_displaySection.xhtml page for each section (scratchpad b4/raw/*.html), tag-stripped and whitespace-normalized with the same normalizer datasetTools/verifySources.ts applies, sliced to a contiguous subdivision window between literal markers (scratchpad b4/buildSources.mjs), then ingested via datasetTools/ingestSources.ts, which recomputed each sha256 from the excerpt bytes. Effective dates were taken verbatim from each page history line and recorded in discovery_notes. All eight are official leginfo pages; no aggregator-hosted record was added.
new_source_records.live_verification: datasetTools/verifySources.ts --live over the eight new records on 2026-07-27: 8/8 live_excerpt_found, drift 0. Whole-registry offline verification after ingestion: 86/86, drift 0.

case_source_officiality.b8a_note: Two pre-existing CIT-REAL-* case records are reused by this batch and remain subject to the open B8a officiality audit: CIT-REAL-13 (Briggs v. Eden Council for Hope and Opportunity, 19 Cal.4th 1106, excerpt hosted at scocal.stanford.edu) in drafting-011, and CIT-REAL-1 (Navellier v. Sletten, 29 Cal.4th 82, same host) in drafting-012. No new aggregator-hosted case excerpt was added. Each dependent criterion is confined to what that record own excerpt states — for Briggs, the single held proposition that a movant need not separately demonstrate public significance; for Navellier, the standard sentence the record carries plus the citation itself. When B8a re-anchors these two records to the official California Courts opinion archive, drafting-011-c4 and drafting-012-c5 inherit the new locator and hash without any change to their wording.

grounding_rule: No criterion requires outside legal memory. Every material criterion in this batch can be verified against the frozen evidence packet attached to its own task.

hard_failure_assertions.MALFORMED_DELIVERABLE_grounding: Used only where the prompt explicitly instructs the drafter to close the declaration with the certification California requires in place of a sworn affidavit, and the task carries a criterion and proposition grounded in Cal. Civ. Proc. Code section 2015.5 (STAT-CAL-CIV-PROC-CODE-2015-5, fetched and ingested in this batch). The assertion checks for the two literal recitals the statute prescribes.
hard_failure_assertions.WRONG_EFFECTIVE_DATE_grounding: Each date is stated verbatim in the excerpt for that task: FAM 1615(c)(2)(B) (agreements executed on or after January 1, 2020) and FAM 852(e) (transmutations made before January 1, 1985).
hard_failure_assertions.MISSED_CONTROLLING_CONTRARY_AUTHORITY_gr: FAM 4058(b)(3) — incarceration or involuntary institutionalization shall not be treated as voluntary unemployment — is inside drafting-002 own evidence packet and cuts against the position the prompt asks the drafter to argue.

no_wrong_jurisdiction_assertion: No WRONG_JURISDICTION assertion was written; nothing in the registry grounds one for these drafting requests.
